items.title: Burp Suite’s Scanning Arsenal Powered With Detection for Critical React2Shell Vulnerabilities
items.description: PortSwigger has enhanced Burp Suite’s scanning arsenal with the latest update to its ActiveScan++ extension, introducing detection for the critical React2Shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-55182 and CVE-2025-66478). This server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw in React applications allows attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands, potentially leading to full remote code execution (RCE) on…

items.title: Apple, Google and Samsung May Enable Always-On GPS in India
items.description: The Indian government is currently evaluating a controversial proposal from the telecom industry that would mandate smartphone manufacturers to enable “always-on” satellite location tracking. This move has sparked significant opposition from major technology companies, including Apple, Google, and Samsung, who argue it poses serious privacy and security risks.
